what_it_does.text: Trent operates as a platform with multiple retail brand propositions and capabilities, offering exclusive fashion brands, value retail formats, convenience stores, and online retail across concepts like Westside, Zudio, Samoh, Burnt Toast, and Star.

other_points.text: The company expands its footprint across the country through stores and online propositions including westside.com and association with Tata Neu.
It facilitates the distribution of Zara and Massimo Dutti products in India through respective stores via subsidiaries and alliances.

not_found: Exact quantitative revenue shares for individual business segments

guidance.method: LLM extracts quotes; FINN verifies the quote and computes the verdict against reported numbers.

claims.text: Revenue compounded at 50.6% a year over five years (FY21→FY26).
Operating margin expanded by 14.3 pp over FY21→FY26.
Debt/equity is 0.30x (FY27), vs 0.43x three years earlier.
Over 6 years, operating cash flow was 1.33x reported profit.
Cumulative free cash flow (CFO − capex) was ₹1,961 cr over 6 years.

verification.method: Each AI claim must cite a passage or metric; every number in it must appear in what it cites.

limitations: No earnings-call transcripts listed; guidance tracking is unavailable.
